target: Flávio Bolsonaro most valid presidential runoff votes in Distrito Federal; not national winner. TSE ambiguity tie/fallback June30 2027 acknowledged.

official_round1.role: Regional baseline/transfer plausibility only, not independent repeated poll or guaranteed runoff floor.

local_poll.valid_share_rounding_note: 49/(49+43)=53.26%, not54. Published valid54 is anchor; .5pp rounding/reweight component included.

newer_national_context.scope: National, not DF. Half of national one-point change translated subjectively into local mean; bounded countermodels vary this assumption.

vote_share_model.model_limit: Error components/independence and .5 national transfer are judgment, not historical calibration. No national-level share substituted for local share; new DF poll missing is retained uncertainty.

reasoning: Direct local survey favors Flávio but was fielded18 days before runoff. First-round51.31vs38.11 supports a DF advantage without assuming voters cannot switch or turnout cannot change. Newer national poll shows one-point valid-share deterioration; apply half to local mean and retain large campaign/nonresponse/turnout error. Sampling MOE alone would greatly overstate confidence. Disqualification/fallback/admin tail remains.
reopen: New registered DF runoff poll or material candidate/turnout/legal news; margin surviving model sensitivity plus current entry gates.
